description: This Java class 'ConciergeWrapper' provides utility methods to wrap signals in a hashable envelope for routing purposes in a concierge service. It includes a method to create envelopes and generate hash keys based on signal resource types and entity IDs.

classes.name: ConciergeWrapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to wrap signals in hashable envelopes for routing the concierge service.

methods.name: wrapForEnforcerRouter
methods.description: Wraps a Signal object into a ConsistentHashableEnvelope with a hash key based on the signal's resource type and entity ID.
